learning.title: RSS feeds and source verification
learning.body: An RSS feed is a publisher’s machine-readable list of recent articles. It helps collect headlines in one place, but a feed excerpt is not independent verification and may omit important context.
learning.tryThis: Pick one item in this edition. Compare its feed excerpt with the linked article, note what context is missing, and look for a primary source before sharing a strong claim.

notes: Compiled from public RSS feeds. Feed excerpts are publisher-supplied and have not been independently verified; open the linked original before relying on a claim.
